news.headline: uniQure to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: uniQure confirmed it will report Q2 2026 financial results before market open on July 29, 2026, with a conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET. Analysts expect revenue of roughly $5.4 million and a per-share loss around $0.82, with investors focused on cash runway and BLA-timeline commentary.

news.headline: uniQure CEO Matthew Kapusta Sells Shares After Option Exercise Under 10b5-1 Plan
news.summary: CEO Matthew Kapusta exercised options for 21,082 shares at $19.39 and sold the same number at an average of $45.16 under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan, worth about $952,000. uniQure's CMO also sold 30,000 shares on June 30 under a similar plan, while a JPMorgan Chase 13G filing disclosed a new roughly 7% passive institutional stake around the same time.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Closing of Upsized Public Offering and Full Exercise by Underwriters of Option to Purchase Additional Shares
news.summary: uniQure closed an upsized underwritten public offering of 5,686,813 ordinary shares at $45.50 per share (priced June 23), raising roughly $259 million in gross proceeds. Proceeds are earmarked for AMT-130 commercialization readiness, confirmatory studies, and other pipeline development.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Preliminary Data on the First Cohort in the Phase I/IIa Clinical Trial of AMT-260 in Refractory Mesial Temporal Lobe Epilepsy
news.summary: In the low-dose cohort (n=6) of the AMT-260 gene therapy trial for drug-resistant epilepsy, 3 of 6 patients showed 79-100% reductions in disabling seizures at months 4-6, while the therapy was generally well tolerated with no serious adverse events. Enrollment in a higher-dose second cohort is ongoing, with updated data expected in H1 2027.

news.headline: Wall Street Analysts Raise Price Targets on uniQure After FDA Update
news.summary: Following the FDA's reversal on AMT-130, analysts including Goldman Sachs, H.C. Wainwright, Leerink, Mizuho, RBC Capital and Barclays sharply raised price targets or upgraded the stock (e.g. Wainwright to $80, Mizuho to $68, RBC to $65, Barclays to Overweight). The stock carries an overall Strong Buy consensus from Wall Street.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Plan for BLA Submission for AMT-130 in Huntington's Disease
news.summary: The FDA agreed that uniQure's 3-year Phase I/II AMT-130 data (75% slowing of Huntington's disease progression vs. external control, p=.003) can support a near-term accelerated-approval BLA submission, reversing its earlier request for a full randomized trial. uniQure plans to submit the BLA in Q3 2026 while continuing to align with the FDA on a confirmatory study design using a standard-of-care control.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: uniQure reports second-quarter 2026 financial results before market open with a conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET; investors are watching for BLA-timeline, cash-runway, and confirmatory-study updates.

catalysts.label: FDA BLA submission for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Biologics License Application seeking accelerated approval of AMT-130 for Huntington's disease, following FDA agreement that 3-year data can support the filing; not yet submitted as of late July 2026.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA marketing authorization application for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: In parallel with the US filing, uniQure plans to submit a Marketing Authorization Application to the UK's MHRA for AMT-130, after a constructive pre-submission meeting.

catalysts.label: Confirmatory study design alignment / initiation
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to finalize with the FDA the design of the required confirmatory study for AMT-130 (using a standard-of-care control arm) ahead of or alongside the BLA submission.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 higher-dose cohort enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: Enrollment in the second, higher-dose cohort of the Phase I/IIa AMT-260 trial for refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy is expected to complete around mid-to-late 2026.

catalysts.label: Updated AMT-260 Phase I/IIa data readout
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to present updated safety and efficacy results, including higher-dose cohort data, from the ongoing AMT-260 epilepsy trial.

pulse: uniQure reports Q2 2026 results today (July 29) riding a strong rally since mid-June, when the FDA reversed course and agreed that 3-year AMT-130 data can support an accelerated-approval BLA for Huntington's disease, with the filing still targeted for Q3 2026 (not yet submitted) alongside a parallel UK MHRA application. The company bolstered its balance sheet with a $259 million upsized equity offering in late June, and early AMT-260 epilepsy data gave the pipeline a second positive data point, while Wall Street analysts have turned broadly bullish with sharply higher price targets; insider share sales by the CEO and CMO have continued under pre-set 10b5-1 plans alongside a new JPMorgan 13G stake. Near-term focus is on today's earnings call for commentary on cash runway, the confirmatory study design, and BLA submission timing.
